title: Climate Observation To Local Decision
summary: Follow global climate baselines, seasonal forecasts, public radar data, national elevation design, transportation-risk synthesis, interpretation, local exposure, authority, implementation, and outcomes.
current_state_summary: FTFN now has a multi-record observation shelf and an explicit dependency map showing why data availability must pass through coverage, validation, interpretation, local exposure, authority, action, and measurement before becoming a local claim.
current_state: NOAA supplies dated annual and seasonal climate observation records with global and probabilistic boundaries.
NISAR has crossed into public science-data availability, while archive completion, validation, user adoption, and decision use remain downstream.
USGS has defined a next-generation 3DEP model based on improved quality, refresh, elevation-hydrography integration, and analysis-ready delivery.
NCA5 identifies transportation climate risk across planning, design, operations, maintenance, workforce, and technology.
EPA distinguishes national inventory and threshold-based facility reporting, preventing incompatible emissions comparisons.

dependency_stack.current_state: NOAA, NASA, USGS, and NOAA Ocean Exploration publish climate, radar, elevation, mapping, and field-operation records.
dependency_stack.boundary: Availability does not prove complete coverage, correct product selection, validated interpretation, or local use.

dependency_stack.current_state: Each rail carries a time, geography, method, coverage, version, and uncertainty boundary.
dependency_stack.boundary: A global ranking, radar image, elevation product, or expedition observation cannot be converted directly into a local causal claim.

dependency_stack.current_state: NCA5 identifies the planning, design, operating, maintenance, workforce, and capital layers through which climate evidence reaches transportation.
dependency_stack.boundary: The national assessment does not name the asset condition, authority, funding, or implemented response for a local system.

dependency_stack.current_state: The pathway identifies the plan, budget, permit, procurement, construction, operating, and outcome records needed after interpretation.
dependency_stack.boundary: FTFN does not claim a changed decision or measured benefit without those records.

evidence_limits: The pathway joins different datasets and assessments to expose a conversion sequence; it does not treat them as interchangeable.
Global and national evidence does not establish local hazards, losses, adaptation, resilience, emissions, or causation.
Data availability does not prove institutional adoption, funded implementation, or measured outcomes.
next_records: product-specific coverage, calibration, version, quality, resolution, and revision records.
regional models, ground truth, assumptions, uncertainty, and validation.
named local assets, hazards, exposure, vulnerability, decision authority, plans, budgets, permits, procurements, and construction.
operating changes, service, losses, resilience, yield, water, safety, and other measured outcomes.

A real same-entity artifact returned through its Phase 67 qualification packet with authority, scope, date, method, denominator or not-applicable basis, exceptions, correction trail, decision receipt, and complete propagation.
